name: Charges 14
definition: Provides information on the charges related to the payment transaction.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Transaction charges to be paid by the charge bearer.

Agent.name: Agent
Agent.definition: Agent that takes the transaction charges or to which the transaction charges are due.

AgentAccount.name: Agent Account
AgentAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the agent to which a credit entry will be made as a result of the charges.
